short_description: Turn pasted notes into simple local flashcards.
user_flow: Review generated question and answer cards.

files.content:
Study Card Builder

No cards yet.

This uses local mocked card-building rules, not live AI.

function sentenceCards(text){return text.split(/[.!?]+/).map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean).slice(0,6).map((s,i)=>({q:'Question '+(i+1)+': what is the key point?',a:s}));}function buildCards(){const notes=document.getElementById('notes-input').value.trim();const cards=sentenceCards(notes||'Add one useful note before studying.');document.getElementById('card-output').innerHTML=cards.map(card=>'
'+card.q+'

Answer: '+card.a+'

').join('')+'

Local mocked flashcards only.

';}document.getElementById('build-cards').addEventListener('click',buildCards);

# Study Card Builder

Run `python3 -m http.server 8080` and open `index.html`.

Flashcards are built with local deterministic rules.

# Test Plan

- Open the app.
- Paste notes with several sentences.
- Click Build Cards.
- Confirm cards appear in the card output area.

test_instructions: Paste notes, build cards, and confirm the card output updates locally.
codex_next_prompt: Improve the local flashcard helper without adding dependencies.
mocked_parts: Card creation is local and deterministic, not live AI.
